messages.subject: Didn't converge! warning with switch.order()
parts:
Looks like there are some cases where people get the "didn't converge" warning with other functions.. anyone seen it when simply switching order of markers?
I checked and I don't have high crossover individuals, though my map is far from perfect.  If I run est.map afterwards, it doesn't happen again.. ok to ignore this warning?
Thanks!

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Didn't converge! warning with switch.order()
parts:
After markers get moved, there's a call to est.map to re-estimate the inter-marker distances. This is giving the warning about "didn't converge".

I'd re-estimate the map using

newmap <- est.map(mycross)
mycross <- replace.map(mycross, newmap)

karl
